items.draft:
READY FOR APPROVAL — nothing sent

Carla’s checklist:
1. Gather and attach the previous 3D model, GA, presentations, material boards, shop drawings and typical details.
2. Review and finalize the presentation with Francesca, incorporating the client’s feedback.
3. Set a weekly or biweekly WhatsApp meeting cadence.
4. Schedule the Monaco client meeting to finalize design decisions.
5. Confirm the required files with the interior contractor: Rhino files, materials list and images.

Message ready for the team:
Hello Unzile and team,

As agreed during the kickoff, we will begin with the main deck, focusing on the main salon and main cabin. The direction will be more modern, with straighter lines and stronger contrast between dark woods, light floors and deep-green stone.

I am organizing the previous 3D model and the supporting reference materials. Francesca and I are also finalizing the presentation with the client’s feedback.

Please send the team’s email addresses and confirm any additional file formats you need. We can also establish a weekly or biweekly follow-up meeting; please suggest the best days and times.

Thank you,
Carla
